scope: One explicitly approved, dedicated Agent Mesh LXC API/GUI and separately authorized opt-in CLI connectors; no unrelated workload rollout
migration: Review candidate additive SQL under the existing PostgreSQL transaction/advisory lock. Confirm existing rows are preserved, activity references and deletion behavior match the contract, and current deletion previews include native activity.
gates: Separately authorized provider compatibility checks where required
Exact frozen web/binary hashes and expected previous release
Private read-only before/after consistency checks with documented volatile-field exclusions
codex_limitation: Normal interactive approval of generated MCP/hooks remains required. Do not bypass hook trust. A new or changed provider CLI or hook definition requires renewed compatibility review; source-level tests do not prove live provider behavior.
activation: After separate authorization, guarded update.sh creates a private pg_dump, verifies its archive index, switches matching binary/assets and requires trusted HTTPS health. It does not migrate keys, listeners, queues, provider settings or conversations.
rollback: Code/assets only to the retained previous release. Never automatically restore or drop the database. Native records remain; avoid project deletion under older code whose preview omits them.
postchecks: Trusted HTTPS and existing key/history/ACL continuity
Native activity read authorization and response schema
Existing application data preserved under the approved comparison rules
Private backup copied off-container and its transfer checksum verified
not_included: Automatic model jobs or idle wakeup
Capturing prompts, commands, transcripts or hidden reasoning
